name: repository

steps.action: C30 step 1: Documents opens the flat repository and Recent lists at most five newest current Versions
steps.actual: Recent drew 5 rows in newest-current-Version-first order, matching the seam's own five-row answer; it is an upload order, not a reading history

steps.action: C30 step 2: the Owner filter narrows to each owner kind this role may reach
steps.actual: All four Owner arms returned reachable paper (Contracts 100, Matters 100, Entities 71, Knowledge 35); Clear all widened the list again

steps.action: C30 step 3: Record narrows to one owning record and unlocks a Folder filter
steps.actual: Typing C-408 into Record and choosing the match narrowed the list to that Contract and made Folder available; Record root returned only paper filed outside its folders

steps.action: C30: a Knowledge owner is offered no Folder filter, and the seam refuses one
steps.actual: With Knowledge chosen the Folder control was absent, and asking the seam for a Knowledge folder answered 400. Knowledge Folders organize items, not Documents inside one, as the guide says

steps.action: C30 step 4: Format, Kind, Uploader, Counterparty and the two dates all have to match
steps.actual: A Format + Kind + Uploader + both-dates combination returned only rows matching every one of them and still held today's upload with an inclusive same-day window; changing one value dropped the row, and the Counterparty filter answered Contract-owned paper only

steps.action: C30 step 13/17: Recent is hidden while filters are active and returns when they are cleared
steps.actual: With an Owner filter active the Recent section disappeared and came back on Clear all, exactly as the guide notes

steps.action: C30 step 25: opening a row lands on its owning record with the current Version selected
steps.actual: Opening the repository row landed on C-408's Documents tab with the reader on version 2, the current round. The repository points at the owning record rather than reading paper itself

steps.action: C30: the repository answers this reader's own reach, which for an Administrator includes Confidential records
steps.actual: The Confidential Contract's paper was listed for the Administrator and correctly attributed to C-411; reach, not the filter, is what decides, and an Administrator's reach covers every Contract

steps.action: C30 step 29: Show archived reveals archived rows and Restore brings one back
steps.actual: Archiving took the row out of the ordinary list; Show archived brought it back with an Archived marker and the row Restore returned it live with its Version intact
